newsitem.title: INDONESIA: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - Oct 1.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - Oct 1.

text.p: Following is a summary of major Indonesian political and business stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Jakarta. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (6221) 384-6364. Fax: (6221)
Indonesia will reject issues harmful to its national interests at the upcoming World Trade Organisation meeting in December, Trade and Industry Minister Tunky Ariwibowo said.

Trade and Industry Minister Tunky Ariwibowo said that around 4,000 Timor cars being held by Indonesian customs should be released soon. The controversial Timor cars are being held while checks are made on the company's ability to use 20 percent local components in the first year of manufacture. Tunky said that bank guarantees given by Timor are sufficient to approve the release of the cars.
An Indonesian pilot was arrested as he tried to smuggle 8,000 Ecstasy pills aboard a Garuda flight from Holland to the holiday island of Bali.
Indonesia has offered tax incentives to importers of goods which are to be re-exported within a twelve month period.
Tobacco manufacturer Putera Sampurna has bought a 9.81 stake in car manufacturer PT Astra International.
